summary: 8-phase TDD plan created. Guard-first: build a doc-flag lint deriving allowed tokens from parser._actions (Phase 1), demonstrate RED under strict xfail with a violation inventory (Phase 2), fix docs in five file-owned parallel phases (3-7, wave 3) covering ~47 fabricated flag tokens across 10 files plus the live --output-dir suggestion string in output/errors.py, then remove the xfail and run the full gate (Phase 8). Plan-time verification amended two research conclusions: --iso-debug IS real (a dev_cli.py wrapper flag consumed pre-argparse, must be allowlisted not 'fixed'), and six further fabricated flags were found beyond the report's four findings (--benchmark, --test-all-settings, --profile, --generate-license family, -t).
